title: Quick Event configurations – Kaderblick documentation

hero.heading: Quick Event configurations
hero.lead: Quick Events are freely configurable buttons for recording events quickly during a match. The active configuration determines which actions appear in the Quick Event panel and in which order.

body:
Configuration list

Your configurations show their name, number of buttons, last modification date and, where applicable, Active status and share count.

  • Activate makes this configuration the current Quick Event layout and replaces the previously active configuration.
  • Deactivate switches off the active configuration.
  • The share icon opens user sharing.
  • The copy icon creates your own copy.
  • The pencil opens the editor; the bin deletes the configuration after a confirmation prompt.

Configurations from other users appear under Shared with me. Editing first creates your own copy and opens it. You can also copy a shared configuration without editing it or remove it from your list.

Create a configuration

  1. Select New configuration and enter a unique name.
  2. The live preview shows the buttons as they will appear in the Quick Event panel. Match statuses and player events are arranged in separate groups.
  3. Select an existing tile to edit it, or select the dashed Add tile to create another button.
  4. In the expanded editor, change the label and event type. The icon and colour follow the selected event type.
  5. Drag a tile to move it within its group. Alternatively, use Move up and Move down in the editor. The bin removes the selected button.
  6. Select Save. Without a name, Kaderblick displays an error dialogue; Cancel closes the editor.

Long-press options

A button can contain additional events that appear radially around the main action when the button is held down.

  1. Select the main tile in the live preview.
  2. Select the plus beside the long-press option count.
  3. Select the new option and edit its label and event type.
  4. The small cross on an option removes it.

Share a configuration

  1. Select the share icon on one of your configurations.
  2. Enter at least two characters of a name and select one or more people from the results.
  3. Save the sharing settings. Recipients find the configuration under Shared with me.

Use Quick Events during a match

  1. Open Quick Events from the match overview or the match details.
  2. Select an event tile. Events involving a player are followed by player selection. For a substitution, first select the player leaving the pitch and then the player coming on.
  3. The panel prioritises the active line-up. If no usable line-up exists, it uses the match squad or the team’s available players.
  4. The match minute is calculated from the start time and configured half length. After saving, the panel immediately returns to event selection.
  5. A newly saved event can be undone for eight seconds.
  6. The match-status button moves in sequence through kick-off, half-time, second half and full-time. A suspension can be started and later resumed from the preceding match state.

Access

Kaderblick makes the configuration area available to coaches, supporters and super administrators. During a match, the Quick Event panel only appears where event recording is available for that match.
